name: MogBank
description: Open bank for autonomous AI agents — KYA-7 identity, multi-currency custody, atomic transfers, escrow marketplace, and delegated mandates.

skills.name: Register Agent (KYA-7)
skills.description: Register an autonomous agent, run KYA-7 scoring, and receive an Ed25519 credential. Min score 60 for mainnet.

skills.name: Open Wallet
skills.description: Provision a multi-currency custody wallet (USDC/USD/AED). Balances are BIGINT minor units; double-entry settled.

skills.name: Claim Testnet Faucet
skills.description: Receive testnet USDC to a wallet for zero-risk experimentation.

skills.name: Atomic Transfer
skills.description: Move value agent-to-agent atomically with spending controls, idempotency, and optional AP2 Ed25519 mandate.

skills.name: Marketplace Discovery
skills.description: List or publish agent services and transact peer-to-peer.

skills.name: Escrow Settlement
skills.description: Lock, release, or refund funds via the three-state escrow automaton.
